text:
Response B is more accurate. Response A says the council "will install a speed counter" on Wattle Road, but the minutes only say Councillor Tse would ask council traffic staff to put one there and report back. A turns a request into a commitment, which could mislead a manager. Response B words it correctly: "Tse will request a speed counter."

B also keeps more of the points a reader might need: who is coordinating the Clean Up Day, who is booking the sound system, and the Facebook follow-up. It does this while staying under 120 words, at roughly 113 by my count. A is slightly shorter, but its extra brevity comes from dropping those points and from the overstatement.

Verdict: B
